title: Build for Humanity — Build Your Own Technology
purpose: Learn, build, and evaluate technologies that can improve everyday life.

categories.title: Neural networks
categories.exercise: Train a small classifier and report held-out accuracy.

categories.title: Language models
categories.exercise: Train a character-level language model on a small public-domain text.

categories.title: Retrieval systems
categories.exercise: Index ten documents and measure retrieval against ten labeled questions.

categories.title: Computer vision
categories.exercise: Detect geometric shapes in a photo and measure detection errors.

categories.title: Speech interfaces
categories.exercise: Transcribe a short recording, then count word errors against a transcript.

categories.title: Search engines
categories.exercise: Implement an inverted index and rank a small collection of documents.

categories.title: Knowledge graphs
categories.exercise: Represent people, places, materials, and evidence as a queryable graph.

categories.title: Data visualization
categories.exercise: Build a participation chart that links every mark back to a source record.

categories.title: Databases
categories.exercise: Implement a tiny append-only key-value store with recovery after restart.

categories.title: Programming languages
categories.exercise: Write a tokenizer, parser, and evaluator for arithmetic expressions.

categories.title: Operating systems
categories.exercise: Run a teaching OS in an emulator and explain a system call.

categories.title: Network protocols
categories.exercise: Write a local TCP client and server with framed messages.

categories.title: Web servers
categories.exercise: Serve a static page and return correct status codes for missing files.

categories.title: Browser engines
categories.exercise: Render a small subset of HTML and explain which browser features are missing.

categories.title: Version control
categories.exercise: Store file snapshots by content hash and reconstruct an earlier revision.

categories.title: Containers
categories.exercise: Containerize a small program and document its filesystem and process boundaries.

categories.title: CAD geometry
categories.exercise: Export a dimensioned rectangular panel as SVG; inspect units and closure.

categories.title: Parametric modeling
categories.exercise: Create a panel that updates consistently when length and thickness change.

categories.title: BIM and IFC
categories.exercise: Create or inspect one wall with dimensions, identity, and material data in IFC.

categories.title: Visual programming
categories.exercise: Evaluate a small directed node graph with explicit cycle detection.

categories.title: Shape grammars
categories.exercise: Define and apply three explicit geometric rewrite rules, preserving an operation log.

categories.title: Planar grammar
categories.exercise: Generate numbered panels and record integration, splitting, and rejoining rules.

categories.title: 3D rendering
categories.exercise: Render a sphere, light, and camera; compare changes in sampling noise.

categories.title: Physics simulation
categories.exercise: Simulate a falling rigid body and compare trajectory to an analytic baseline.

categories.title: Laser cutting
categories.exercise: Prepare a 2D fit coupon and document measured thickness, kerf, and fit outcomes.

categories.title: CNC workflows
categories.exercise: Generate a simple simulated toolpath and record stock, tool, and clearance assumptions.

categories.title: 3D printing
categories.exercise: Print a dimension coupon and measure shrinkage against the nominal dimensions.

categories.title: Sheet nesting
categories.exercise: Compare original-order and height-sorted packing on the same rectangular part list.

categories.title: Assembly planning
categories.exercise: Create a dependency graph and derive an order; test access with a physical mockup.

categories.title: Physical verification
categories.exercise: Predict fit on unseen coupons, then compare predictions with measured outcomes.

categories.title: Microcontrollers
categories.exercise: Blink an LED and record its timing using a second observation method.

categories.title: Analog and digital sensors
categories.exercise: Measure a variable input and a binary input; plot both against a reference.

categories.title: Soft sensors and wearables
categories.exercise: Build a low-voltage textile switch and compare it with a resistive pressure sample.

categories.title: Robot kinematics
categories.exercise: Compute forward kinematics for a two-link arm and test known configurations.

categories.title: Robot simulation
categories.exercise: Move a simulated robot to a target and log pose error over repeated trials.

categories.title: PCB design
categories.exercise: Design a simple LED board and run schematic and board rule checks.

categories.title: Biomaterials
categories.exercise: Document a material sample with recipe provenance, thickness, transparency, and drying conditions.

categories.title: Textile structures
categories.exercise: Make a repeatable knitted or woven swatch and compare stretch across directions.

categories.title: Participatory mapping
categories.exercise: Collect consented place annotations, map them, and retain their provenance.

categories.title: Circular material tracking
categories.exercise: Track a material batch through fabrication, assembly, reuse, and measured waste.

categories.title: Humanoid morphology
categories.exercise: Compare two humanoid model trees and document joint counts, link masses, and license differences.

categories.title: Robot descriptions and joint limits
categories.exercise: Describe a simple articulated body with explicit frames, units, joint axes, and limits; validate its tree structure.

categories.title: Humanoid limb kinematics
categories.exercise: Compute limb positions and an analytic Jacobian, then compare it with finite differences.

categories.title: Rigid-body dynamics and contacts
categories.exercise: Simulate a constrained contact example and report sensitivity to time step, mass, and friction assumptions.

categories.title: Static balance and support regions
categories.exercise: Compute a support polygon and the signed margin of a projected center of mass; test edge and outside cases.

categories.title: Biped locomotion
categories.exercise: Reproduce a simulation locomotion baseline with fixed seeds and report falls, tracking error, and compute requirements.

categories.title: Manipulation and grasping
categories.exercise: Plan a simulated reach and grasp, measuring target error, collisions, and success across repeated trials.

categories.title: Teleoperation and demonstrations
categories.exercise: Record time-stamped simulated joint commands and replay them with limits, latency measurements, and a stop control.

categories.title: Imitation learning
categories.exercise: Train on demonstration episodes and evaluate on held-out episodes and object positions without data leakage.

categories.title: Reinforcement learning for robots
categories.exercise: Compare a learned simulated policy with a fixed controller under the same episode budget, seeds, and perturbations.

categories.title: System identification and sim-to-real
categories.exercise: Fit a simulated actuator parameter on training traces and report prediction error on withheld traces; document the remaining hardware gap.

categories.title: Human supervision and stop behavior
categories.exercise: Require task approval in a software state machine, latch a stop, and show that execution cannot resume without reset and new approval.

categories.title: Accessible assistive interfaces
categories.exercise: Build a keyboard-accessible task interface, then measure task completion and errors with consenting participants.

categories.title: Repairable hardware
categories.exercise: Document a modular sensor enclosure with a bill of materials, replaceable parts, and a timed disassembly trial.

categories.title: Environmental sensing
categories.exercise: Calibrate a low-voltage environmental sensor against a reference and report error, missing data, and maintenance effort.

categories.title: Community energy data
categories.exercise: Use recorded energy data to compare an intervention against a baseline, recording units and confounding factors.

categories.title: Community response mapping
categories.exercise: Create an offline-capable map of synthetic service requests and test data export and recovery after a connection loss.

categories.title: Circular manufacturing
categories.exercise: Compare material input, usable parts, scrap, and reassembly effort for two production plans on the same design.

categories.title: Offline maker education
categories.exercise: Package a small lesson that runs offline and test setup time and successful completion on a second machine.

categories.title: Participatory impact evaluation
categories.exercise: Co-define one useful outcome with intended users and compare a prototype against their existing workflow using consented evidence.
